source.title: TNoodle 1.0.1 Official Release
source.content:
TNoodle-WCA-1.0.1 is now available on the Scrambles page
The following changes have been made since the previous version:

- **New UI**: The “Legacy UI” and “Log in with WCA” features have been merged into one single-page application.
- **WCIF**: TNoodle now has more convenience features and better integration with other software in the toolchain.
- **Square-1 now uses a specialised solver** courtesy of Chen Shuang. This means that overall scramble generation time should decrease by a significant margin if your competition includes the Square-1 event.

Upcoming competitions should use TNoodle-WCA-1.0.1 to generate new scrambles whenever possible. Due to the current situation with competition restrictions, there will be an extended transition period meaning that **TNoodle-WCA-0.15.1 will stay an official version for three weeks until September 7, 2020**. Scrambles that have already been generated using TNoodle-WCA-0.15.1 can still be used until that date.

Please remember that official competitions must use a current version of the official scramble program. This is always available from:
[https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/)

translation.title: TNoodle 1.0.1 正式发布
translation.content:
TNoodle-WCA-1.0.1 现已在打乱页面提供下载。与上一版本相比，本次更新包括：

* **新界面：**“旧版界面”和“使用 WCA 登录”两项功能已合并为一个单页应用。
* **WCIF：**TNoodle 增加了更多便捷功能，并改善了与工作流程中其他软件的集成。
* **Square-1 现在采用专用求解器，**感谢 Chen Shuang 的贡献。如果比赛包含 Square-1 项目，生成打乱的总耗时应会大幅减少。

即将举行的比赛应尽可能使用 TNoodle-WCA-1.0.1 生成新打乱。考虑到目前的比赛限制，过渡期有所延长，**TNoodle-WCA-0.15.1 将继续作为官方版本保留三周，直至 2020 年 9 月 7 日**。此前已用 TNoodle-WCA-0.15.1 生成的打乱，截至该日期仍可使用。

请记住，官方比赛必须使用当前有效版本的官方打乱程序。最新版本始终可从以下页面获取：
[https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/)
